st.title: Categories & tags
st.sub: The order of your categories and collections, and the badge on a product card: change them here and the shop shows them straight away.
st.note: Grab the handle on the left of a row and drag it to move it (on a phone, press and drag). Or use the arrow buttons. Hiding never deletes anything.
st.readOnly: You can look but not change. Changing these needs the product editing permission.
st.saved: Saved. The shop shows it now.
st.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet.
st.dragHelp: Press and drag, or use the arrow keys

err.STALE: Someone else changed this just now. It has been read again, so please make your change again.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something here is not right. Check the words and try again.
err.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to change this.
err.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this.
err.other: It was not saved. Please try again.

categories.d: The order your categories show in the shop's menu and tiles. A hidden category is not deleted; the shop just skips it.

collections.d: The order of your collections. A collection you have not placed comes after the placed ones, by name.

tags.d: The badge in the corner of a product card comes from the product's tags. The tag at the top wins when a product has more than one. Nothing set here means the product's first tag, as before.
tags.wordsHelp: Leave empty to show the tag's own name. Write both languages, up to 24 letters each.
tags.bothWords: Write the badge words in both English and Bengali, or leave both empty.
tags.order: The tag at the top is tried first. A tag that is switched off never shows as a badge.
